entries.text: TPC-H and TPC-Havoc DataFrame Q21 now filter the per-order supplier aggregates before joining them to the candidate rows, using semi-joins on Polars and DataFusion and inner joins on unique keys on PySpark and LakeSail. Spark pushes a semi-join through each per-file union of a table, so nested semi-joins multiplied the plan; this made Q21v10 run out of Java heap while planning and made Q21v6 take minutes. Results are unchanged.
